summary: CDSCO directed withdrawal of all ranitidine-containing medicines from Indian markets due to presence of NDMA (N-Nitrosodimethylamine) impurity above acceptable limits. NDMA is classified as a probable human carcinogen.
action_required: Patients on ranitidine should consult their doctor for alternative medications such as famotidine or omeprazole.

summary: CDSCO restricted diacerein use to patients above 18 years, contraindicated in patients with liver disease, and mandated use of lowest effective dose. Risk of severe diarrhoea and hepatotoxicity identified.
action_required: Prescribers should reassess patients on diacerein and monitor liver function.

summary: CDSCO banned nimesulide in children below 12 years due to reports of hepatotoxicity and fatal liver failure in children. Adult formulations remain approved for short-term use.
action_required: Do not administer nimesulide to children under 12. Use paracetamol or ibuprofen as alternatives.

summary: Multiple batches of valsartan recalled globally including India due to NDMA contamination in API manufactured by Zhejiang Huahai Pharmaceutical. Patients to continue medication unless advised by doctor.
action_required: Patients should not stop medication abruptly. Contact prescriber to switch to unaffected product.

summary: CDSCO mandated updated labelling for pioglitazone warning of increased risk of bladder cancer with long-term use (>1 year). Contraindicated in patients with active or previous bladder cancer.
action_required: Regular monitoring recommended. Prescribers should discuss risk-benefit with patients on long-term therapy.

summary: CDSCO and EMA flagged risk of cardiac arrhythmias and sudden cardiac death with domperidone, especially at higher doses. Restricted to lowest effective dose for shortest duration.
action_required: Maximum recommended dose: 10mg three times daily for adults. Contraindicated in patients with cardiac conditions.

summary: CDSCO restricted codeine-containing cough syrups in children below 12 years and adolescents with breathing problems, due to risk of life-threatening respiratory depression in CYP2D6 ultra-rapid metabolizers.
action_required: Avoid codeine in children under 12. In adolescents, use with caution and monitor breathing.

summary: CDSCO banned 344 fixed-dose drug combinations that lacked proof of efficacy, safety or therapeutic justification. Included popular combinations for cough, cold, and pain management.
action_required: Patients on banned FDCs should consult their doctors for alternative single-ingredient medicines.

summary: CDSCO banned the combination of methylergometrine + oxytocin injection. The combination was associated with severe cardiovascular events and uterine rupture when misused.
action_required: Healthcare facilities should remove this combination from stock and use individual approved formulations.

summary: CDSCO withdrew sibutramine (anti-obesity drug) following evidence of increased risk of serious cardiovascular events including non-fatal myocardial infarction and stroke in patients with pre-existing cardiovascular disease.
action_required: Patients previously on sibutramine should consult their doctor for safe weight management alternatives.

summary: CDSCO mandated pregnancy prevention programme for isotretinoin, requiring mandatory pregnancy testing before and during treatment, and two forms of contraception. Drug causes severe foetal abnormalities.
action_required: All prescribers must enrol patients in the pregnancy prevention programme before prescribing.

summary: Valdecoxib (COX-2 inhibitor) withdrawn from Indian and global markets due to increased risk of cardiovascular events and severe skin reactions including Stevens-Johnson syndrome.
action_required: Patients should discontinue use and switch to safer anti-inflammatory alternatives under medical supervision.

summary: This irrational FDC was banned by CDSCO as there was no therapeutic justification for combining these three drugs. No clinical evidence of superior efficacy over individual components.
action_required: Prescribe individual components separately based on patient clinical need.

summary: CDSCO updated labelling for high-dose fluconazole to include risk of QT prolongation and potential cardiac arrhythmias. Also noted teratogenic risk in first trimester pregnancy.
action_required: Avoid in patients with QT prolongation risk factors. Contraindicated in first trimester pregnancy.

summary: PvPI detected signal of bradycardia and hypotension with IV remdesivir in COVID-19 patients, particularly at faster infusion rates. Signal detected through ADR reporting from AMCs across India.
action_required: Administer as slow infusion over 30-120 minutes. Monitor cardiac parameters during administration.
